A Tailscale Funnel starts and serves thi: A Tailscale Funnel starts and serves this gateway at its tailnet address. Funnel answers from the internet, so that address is public, and the dashboard follows it whenever the setting below allows it.
A backup is one JSON file holding every: A backup is one JSON file holding every setting, connection, client key and combo this gateway stores.
A caller holding only an inference key t: A caller holding only an inference key that reaches an operator action is told it holds the wrong kind of credential, which is a different answer from holding none.
A client addressing this model as: A client addressing this model as
A client is one address and tool seen on: A client is one address and tool seen on the key inside a recent window, counted in memory and reset when the gateway restarts.
A client key authenticates a downstream: A client key authenticates a downstream caller against this gateway's inference surface. It never reaches an upstream provider account of its own.
A client key is stored, but only ever sh: A client key is stored, but only ever shown back masked. No usage view re-exposes the value it was issued with.
A failed lookup is not the same as being: A failed lookup is not the same as being current, so this screen will not claim either.
A failed single sign-on counts against t: A failed single sign-on counts against the same five. The counter lives in memory, so restarting the gateway clears every lockout.
A group that measured no outcome reads a: A group that measured no outcome reads as not measured, never as a clean record.
A higher-priority account that was not e: A higher-priority account that was not eligible when the pin was made becomes eligible again.
A key's name and its expiry after it exi: A key's name and its expiry after it exists. Both are set when the key is created, and the update route accepts neither.
A key's own value, in any form. The list: A key's own value, in any form. The list route returns it in full and this screen drops it, so a key is shown once when it is created and never again.
A layer that errors leaves the body unto: A layer that errors leaves the body untouched and writes no record, so this counter can only ever read zero.
A layer that errors leaves the original: A layer that errors leaves the original body untouched, so it costs savings and never correctness.
A local extension is a program on this m: A local extension is a program on this machine that speaks a line-oriented protocol over its own input and output. The bridge relays a connected tool's calls to that program over a server-sent-events connection, opening the extension's process the first time a tool attaches and truncating or collapsing its output before relaying it.
A message goes out when a condition chan: A message goes out when a condition changes, not while it lasts. An account is seeded silently the first time it is seen, so a restart does not replay an old incident. A destination that does not answer delays no request and fails none.
A named outbound path a connection or a: A named outbound path a connection or a provider strategy can be bound to instead of routing directly.
A pin holds a session on one account for: A pin holds a session on one account for one model so a conversation keeps landing where its context already is. It does not move just because ranking would now put another account first. It moves only when one of these happens.
A provider-wide list applies to every co: A provider-wide list applies to every connection that has never had its own. The moment a connection gets its own list, editing it never touches the provider-wide one or any other connection's inherited copy.
A receipt older than the last thousand s: A receipt older than the last thousand switches reads exactly like one that never existed. The gateway does not tell the two apart.
A refused request changes nothing at all: A refused request changes nothing at all. Every other fact reads exactly as it did the moment before the attempt.
A rejected request changes nothing. Stat: A rejected request changes nothing. State reads exactly as it did the moment before the attempt.
A relay process starts and publishes a p: A relay process starts and publishes a public address. The gateway becomes reachable from the internet there, and the dashboard follows it whenever the setting below allows it. Sign-in is the only thing between that address and this surface.
A request from the machine that runs the: A request from the machine that runs the gateway, Tailscale installed there, and Funnel allowed on your tailnet. A join may be asked for first, and it can take a while.
A request from the machine that runs the gateway, or the command-line token.
A request from the machine that runs the gateway. These controls are refused over the relay and the mesh themselves.
A rotation strategy across several proxy: A rotation strategy across several proxy pools for one provider. Only a single pool binding per provider exists in the settings schema, so this screen can bind or clear one pool and nothing more.
A self-registered upstream endpoint beyo: A self-registered upstream endpoint beyond the built-in provider catalog. A connection references it by id.
A session is named by the account it is: A session is named by the account it is on, never by its own identity. The gateway stores only a one-way hash of that identity, and this surface never shows it.
A session lasts 24 hours from the moment: A session lasts 24 hours from the moment it is issued, and is not extended by use.
A session staying on an account that no: A session staying on an account that no longer looks like the best one is this stickiness working, not a fault.
A session, and a provider that is alread: A session, and a provider that is already configured if you are moving to one.
A session, and the values the identity p: A session, and the values the identity provider issued for this gateway.
A signed-in operator session on the mach: A signed-in operator session on the machine that runs the gateway.
A snapshot lives under one of eight fixe: A snapshot lives under one of eight fixed names. An arbitrary name is refused, because a name would otherwise choose where on the machine the content lands.
A stored account is selected for the pro: A stored account is selected for the provider, a real upstream call is made, and it spends real quota against that account. A refresh during the call writes a new stored secret back.
A stored password is never readable back: A stored password is never readable back, here or anywhere else.
A test contacts the provider and commits: A test contacts the provider and commits nothing. A stored client secret cannot be cleared from here, only replaced.
A tool integration is one coding agent i: A tool integration is one coding agent installed on this machine whose configuration the gateway can take over, so its traffic arrives here instead of at its vendor. Some tools expose a configurable endpoint; others can only be reached by intercepting their traffic, which changes machine-wide name resolution and the certificate trust store rather than only the tool.
